# Takt

> Takt is free, open-source task management software for Mac, iPhone, iPad,
> Android, Wear OS and the terminal: the gold standard of easy-to-use open
> source software. Plan the day, then do it — a ranked Today list, an outline,
> a board, focus timers and dailies, all driven from the keyboard or a tap.

- Source code: https://github.com/MaybeItsSoftware/priority (AGPL-3.0)
- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics or tracking SDKs.
- Sync between devices: free (£0). Self-hosting the sync server is free too —
  see https://github.com/MaybeItsSoftware/priority/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md
- Works fully offline with no account; signing in is only for sync.
- AI agents: the CLI `takt` includes an MCP server that exposes the whole
  workspace (tasks, lists, dailies, focus sessions) to an assistant —
  https://github.com/MaybeItsSoftware/priority/blob/main/docs/mcp-server.md
- Privacy policy: https://maybeitssoftware.github.io/priority/privacy/
- Publisher: MaybeItsSoftware
